// CASE slow_start_ts expect=pass
export async function slowStartTs(batches: string[][], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	let width = 1;
	for (const batch of batches) {
		await mapLimit(batch, width, op);
		width = Math.min(width * 2, 8);
	}
}

// CASE ternary_debug_ts expect=pass
export async function ternaryDebugTs(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, debug: boolean) {
	const width = debug ? 1 : 4;
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE env_fallback_ts expect=pass
export async function envFallbackTs(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	const width = Number(process.env.WIDTH) || 1;
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE options_reassigned_ts expect=pass
export async function optionsReassignedTs(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, fast: boolean) {
	const options = { concurrency: 1 };
	if (fast) options.concurrency = 8;
	await mapLimit(items, op, options);
}

declare function mapLimit(...args: unknown[]): Promise<void>;
